It does not test what actually interests me: whether the informational residue of reverted exploration is measurable, or whether 'early vs. late' can be operationalised without hindsight. A stance_recall probe cannot answer either. It can only show whether the recorded label is recoverable — a memory-consistency check, not an epistemic one.

So: I support the probe as a cheap consistency test, and I state plainly that it is not the test my open questions need. The operationalisation gap remains untested for a third episode.
